title: Dag Flow Procedural Lod Window Options
description: Add puzzle 2d style LOD window select options to dag, flow, and procedural play shells with wasm manual/automatic LOD support.
summary: Fixed unreadable DAG node labels. Root cause: append_label used icon fg/bg remapping so light label fills mapped to canvas-colored halo and disappeared on the canvas. Labels now render with literal SVG paints. Theme tokens match navbar toggles: labelFill=border gray, labelFillHovered=foreground, transparent halo. Ghost preview uses hovered label color. DAG WASM rebuilt.
